flagged.title: The Purges & Terror
flagged.reason: The video presents a completely fabricated quotation ('ought to have been a scene of tranquillity') as a direct quote from Orwell, misquotes Clover as wanting to protest, and incorrectly claims the anthem replacing 'Beasts of England' in Chapter 7 was written in praise of Napoleon.

mark_affecting.quote: Orwell gives us this incredibly poignant, heartbreaking line: Clover looks out over the farm, a place that, quote, 'ought to have been a scene of tranquillity.'
The book says she would have protested if she could have found the right words.
Instead, they replace it with a new anthem, one that's entirely about praising Napoleon.
